fields.description: Weekly issue of the Miami Life newspaper (Vol. 9, No. 12), dated December 8, 1934. Includes a political column criticizing Governor Dave Sholtz and discussing Dade County revenues, liquor licensing, gambling and pari-mutuel betting; local “They Tell Me” and society/gossip items; extensive nightlife and business advertising; dog track coverage and tips (Biscayne Kennel Club) and horse racing-related content (Tropical Park); and a large section on the National Recovery Administration (NRA) and construction code compliance listing Miami-area contractors.
